# Iconic Game - Copilot Instructions

## Core Rules

- **No Em Dashes**: Absolutely NEVER use em dashes (Unicode U+2014) in any files, markdown documentation, commit messages, or responses. Always use standard ASCII hyphens/dashes (`-` or `--`).
- **Icons**: Store vector icons in `icons/svg/` using `fill="currentColor"`.
- **Releases**: Tagged versions trigger GitHub Actions release workflow (`release-icons.yml`).
